title: Assessment of Invasive Genetic Testing in Fetuses With Isolated Intrauterine Growth Restriction Diagnosed After 28 Weeks of Gestation at Strasbourg University Hospitals (2016-2023)
official: Assessment of Invasive Genetic Testing Procedures in Fetuses With Isolated Intrauterine Growth Restriction (IUGR) Diagnosed After 28 Weeks of Gestation at Strasbourg University Hospitals Between 2016 and 2023
summary: This study evaluates the diagnostic yield of invasive genetic testing in fetuses with isolated intrauterine growth restriction diagnosed after 28 weeks of gestation, in order to better define indications for invasive procedures and improve clinical counseling.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Maternal age ≥ 18 years
* Referral after 28 weeks of gestation for estimated fetal weight \< 3rd percentile, isolated condition
* Management at Strasbourg University Hospitals between 01/01/2016 and 01/01/2023
* No documented opposition to reuse of medical data for research

Exclusion Criteria:

* Suspected fetal structural anomaly or infectious cause
* Multiple pregnancy
* Incomplete genetic workup
